Name: Bedroom and kitchenette for Guy's who don't have
Author: 7Kana
Description:
[color=#ffff00][size=5]My mods are only here on Nexus, please don't post my work elsewhere![/size][/color]

I was sorry because these four guys in the Vanilla game don't have a bed to sleep in and now they can cook and sleep too.
This adds the bedroom and kitchenette for Marlon, Gil ,Gunther and Sandy, without using mods.
But they won't go to sleep, this is just for aesthetics of the game.

Make a backup of the original files and then copy these to:
For GOG Games
C (or disk where the game is installed):/GOG Games/Stardew Valley/Content/Maps
For Steam
C (or disk where the game is installed):/SteamLibrary/steamMaps/common/Stardew Valley/Content/Maps

At someone's request now also the [CP] version , which of course requires SMAPI to work.
The [CP] Version after unzipping it should be placed in the Mods folder of Stardew Valley.

I did it for me, but now it's for everyone, enjoy!

I thank in advance anyone who believes that my work deserves at least the time to give a thumbs up.

Maybe you might be interested in my other [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/181358142?tab=user+files]Mods[/url]

If you appreciate my work could you buy me a [url=https://ko-fi.com/kanacane]Ko fi[/url] ?
